ruleDefinitions.name: PAExec Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PAExec service installation Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName, ImagePath

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ServiceName = RGX("^PAExec\\-") OR ImagePath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\PAExec\\-")))
